title: Gene expression ATLAS of Arabidopsis thaliana across its lifecycle
author: Jaiswal, Pankaj
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Plant seeds and germinate
steps.instruction: Plant Arabidopsis thaliana (Col‑0) seeds in pots containing commercial potting mix with fertilizers, cover the pots with clear perforated plastic wrap, and keep at 4 °C for 3 days to break dormancy.

steps.title: Transfer seedlings to growth chamber
steps.instruction: After 3 days, transfer the seedlings to an Intellus Ultra growth chamber (Percival Scientific, IA, USA) set to 22‑23 °C, light intensity 120‑150 µmol m⁻² s⁻¹, with a 16 h light / 8 h dark cycle; spray the soil gently with water every 72 hours to maintain humidity at 50‑60 %.

steps.title: Use frozen tissue for extraction
steps.instruction: Collect plant tissue at the desired days after germination, keep the samples frozen, and use these frozen samples for RNA extraction.

steps.title: Extract total RNA
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from the frozen samples following the method described by Filichkin et al., 2010.

steps.title: Isolate large RNA and DNase treat
steps.instruction: From the total RNA, isolate large RNA according to the Qiagen miRNeasy Mini kit manufacturer’s protocol, and treat with RNase‑free DNase (Life Technologies) as recommended.

steps.title: Prepare RNA‑seq libraries
steps.instruction: Prepare RNA‑seq libraries from the purified large RNA using the Illumina TruSeq kit, following the kit’s manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Sequence libraries
steps.instruction: Perform 101 bp paired‑end sequencing of the libraries on an Illumina HiSeq 3000 using the standard Illumina sequencing protocol.
